batch: T10-AUTH7B real RuntimeClient → AuthFlowServices adapter (rev 2: stale-gate invalidation)
scope: Pure Node: the real auth-services adapter, the real AUTH-6B bridge, the real AUTH-6 flow and the real AUTH-5 private port, over synthetic primitives and a labeled Fake service client that mirrors the five real facade signatures and the documented server semantics. No PG, browser, Coordinator, provider, worker-entry, or deploy.
acceptedScope: These runs prove the worker-side adapter only. The Fake client passing is NOT acceptance of pi’s services: Root’s independent PG run found 13+ gate-currentness counterexamples (T10-AUTH7-STATE-ROOT-1369e344-aa12-4319-bf29-49caa3326d75.json) that pi is fixing. The adapter is defensive about staleness regardless of that fix.

facadeCompatibility.how: AuthServiceClient declares the five real methods; `type _ServicesFacadeIsCompatible = RuntimeClient extends AuthServiceClient ? true : never` fails the build on drift.
facadeCompatibility.negativeProof: A deliberately wrong port (authMaterial(proof: string): Promise<number>) makes tsc fail with "Type true is not assignable to type never".

staleGateInvalidation.rule: Every recordAuthCriterion call clears successGateId before anything else; only a well-formed gateId returned for that passed evaluation is stored.
staleGateInvalidation.negativeProof: Removing the single `successGateId = null;` line makes the new case fail (8/9), so the check is not vacuous.
covered: passed → service failure during the next evaluation → refused
passed twice → the second gate replaces the first (grant uses gate-2)
end-to-end failed criterion → no grant, and no stale gate leaks into the next attempt

coverage: the real services carry a form run through material → criteria → capture gate → grant → ticket CAS → capture; every hop uses the frozen proof and the binding session
the capture gateId comes from the passed criterion response, is kept only in the adapter closure, and is invalidated by every new evaluation
a grant is refused without a current passed gate; a non-passed criterion never reaches the service
authorizeExport calls the real beginAuthCapture CAS with the grant and the ticket issued for it; captureAuthState uses the same pair
the returned AuthStateRef is adapted to stateRef, and a ref from another run/epoch is refused
foreign or unknown grant handles are refused before any client call
service errors keep constant codes (LEASE_EXPIRED, POLICY_DENIED, RATE_LIMITED, IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT) and stop the flow with no success and no stateRef
material passes through canonically (form username/password, storage_state storageState) with nothing renamed or parsed
storage_state still never navigates before injection, and the current server refusal of its capture gate is passed through
the leaseToken, gateId, ticket, and authStateId never appear in an outcome, a log object, or an enumerable return
OTP and finish stay absent → the flow blocks with SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE; only an explicit stub passes those steps, and a throwing stub still blocks
interfaceNotesForRoot: The AUTH-5 port compares grant.expiresAt with the binding exactly, so the worker binding must come from the same auth session row (expires_at) that issues the capture grant.
The adapter enforces grant.captureTicket === captureTicket from issueCaptureGrant; an inconsistent service response is refused.
AuthStateRef.authStateId becomes stateRef; runId/authEpoch are checked against the frozen binding before it is handed on.
recordAuthCriterion is only called for a passed result: the service refuses anything else with POLICY_DENIED while the flow reports its own CRITERION_* code.
auth-flow.ts / auth-runtime.ts are unchanged from the accepted AUTH-6B run (hashes listed in unchangedSinceAUTH6B).
notImplemented: finishAuth / import / OTP / handoff are absent: a captured state cannot be finished, so every real run ends blocked with SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE and no stateRef
storage_state capture gates are refused by the current server (POLICY_DENIED); the adapter forwards that instead of inventing a pass
no Worker.once / tick wiring; Stage.auth stays unwired
no PG or real Coordinator path in this batch; Root wires the real PG RuntimeClient→adapter test independently
